title: LazyAgent: Demand-Driven Materialization and Physical Optimization of Agentic Programs
abstract: arXiv:2609.23058v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current agent runtimes that plan before acting generally execute a step once it becomes ready. We present LazyAgent, a unified execution framework for agent-authored programs organized around a live, goal-derived demanded set. LazyAgent refreshes a backward closure from requested outputs as execution state changes and materializes a ready node only when the active goal requires it. This replaces repeated local judgments with one linear-time graph analysis followed by constant-time membership tests, allowing programs to remain broad while execution stays request-specific. On programs that describe more than the current request needs, LazyAgent consistently outperforms the strongest goal-stopping eager baseline by refusing unrelated work before it starts. Adding one unrelated product raises the eager bill by 22.5% and LazyAgent's by 0.0%. LazyAgent saves 42.0% of measured CPU on production scientific workflows and 51.7% of container time o

translated_title: LazyAgent：面向智能体程序的按需物化与物理优化
translated_abstract: 当前在行动前进行规划的智能体运行时系统，通常在某个步骤就绪后便立即执行。我们提出LazyAgent，这是一个面向智能体编写程序的统一执行框架，其核心是一个动态的、由目标导出的“需求集合”。LazyAgent在执行状态变化时，从被请求的输出出发刷新一个反向闭包，仅当活跃目标需要时才物化就绪节点。这将重复的局部判断替换为一次线性时间的图分析加上常数时间的成员测试，使程序可以保持宽泛，而执行始终针对具体请求。在描述内容超出当前请求所需的程序上，LazyAgent通过在无关工作开始之前就拒绝它，始终优于最强的目标停止式急切基线：增加一个无关产品会使急切基线的开销增加22.5%，而LazyAgent的开销增加为0.0%。LazyAgent在生产级科学工作流中节省了42.0%的实测CPU开销，并节省了51.7%的容器时间。
tldr: LazyAgent通过基于活跃目标的按需物化机制，仅执行当前请求真正所需的计算步骤，从而在智能体程序中节省高达42%的CPU开销和51.7%的容器时间。
en_tdlr: LazyAgent introduces demand-driven materialization that executes only the steps required by the active goal, saving up to 42% CPU and 51.7% container time in agentic programs.
